not_granted: No kernel candidate validation or promotion
No runtime import/JIT/GPU correctness proof before a real pilot
No automatic approval of old proposals missing new runner hashes
review_scope: Read-only source inspection and CPU-only subprocess tests. Reviewer did not edit runner files, run GPU jobs or modify ledger.

evidence: rsi_worker.setup_paths removes ambient/current script roots and prepends only the selected bundle paths.
rsi_worker.identities rejects project modules outside the bundle and compares critical module hashes with extracted manifest.
rsi_pair creates distinct persistent processes and validates their reported root/archive/fixture/runtime identities.
Host wrapper mounts baseline and candidate trees read-only.
Each role/archive gets separate SGLang, Triton and Torch extension cache roots.
Worker records actual loaded sgl_kernel_jit shared-object hashes and neighboring transitive dependency-manifest hashes from /proc/self/maps.
Pinned SGLang JIT cache additionally content-addresses direct source and transitive dependencies; per-process memoized digests are safe only because source trees stay immutable.
checks.required_pilot_check: Actual MoE object/dependency identity must correspond to that worker bundle; inspect the concrete records rather than only path labels.

evidence: Second worker initialization waits for first successful init RPC.
Every successful init/configure/measure/close reply follows torch.cuda.synchronize.
Coordinator issues only one RPC at a time, including preparation, graph warmup and correctness work.
AB/BA order alternates across matched pairs; baseline and candidate remain resident but do not intentionally execute concurrently.
Both workers generate each pair from the same seed and pinned fixture/runtime.
Actual captured input bytes, dtypes, shapes and configuration are SHA256-fingerprinted after copying new data.
Coordinator requires matching actual input fingerprints for graph setup and every pair.
Worker checks captured/eager inputs remain unchanged after execution before running the reference oracle.
checks.limit: Full weight tensors are not hashed. Equality is inferred from the same pinned deterministic generator/runtime/seed with cloned preparation and reference checks; report explicitly states this.

evidence: Events are initialized before measurement.
128MiB cache eviction occurs before event start on the same stream.
Events bracket graph replay only.
End event is synchronized before reading duration; durations must be finite positive.
Fingerprint transfers, reference checks and final synchronization remain outside measured event interval.
checks.limit: Per-process context switching and input/reference work may affect operational conditions between trials. Unchanged-control parity is required to validate the proxy.

evidence: Each worker checks five eager reference cases, eager no-local zero output, captured valid output and no-local replay after valid state.
Every timed output is compared with the official reference.
Exact terminal eager/captured/timed/empty-route counts and input immutability claims are required.
Failure in worker RPC, input identity, duration or terminal accounting fails the run.
checks.limit: Source review and fake workers do not establish GPU numerical correctness; runtime pilot must exercise the real worker.

evidence: Archive hashes and exact member/fixture hashes verified before extraction.
Unsafe paths, unsupported tar types and invalid symlinks rejected.
Marker metadata is checked against manifest; file sets/hashes checked again after execution.
Host launcher requires runner/evaluator/benchmark-contract dependencies in reviewed proposal and rechecks all reviewed artifact hashes after execution.
Read-only bind mounts prevent container-side source edits.
checks.limit: Host filesystem ownership and reviewer identities remain procedural trust boundaries, not cryptographic isolation from a malicious root actor.

evidence: Workers run in separate process groups; coordinator acts as child subreaper.
Deadline and SIGTERM failure paths signal whole groups, escalate, reap adopted compiler descendants and reject surviving groups.
Repeated TERM/INT ignored during bounded cleanup.
Host wrapper explicitly removes named Docker container and reaps Docker client.
Nonzero docker inspect is insufficient by itself; only explicit absence messages are accepted as terminal. Unknown daemon/permission state retains supervisor lease.
checks.limit: Container teardown remains the outer boundary for descendants intentionally escaping process groups. SIGKILL/host failure require supervisor recovery and authoritative container inspection.

evidence: Host launcher requires a live matching supervisor-issued lease and nonblocking host device lock.
Pre-run GPU process check rejects an already busy GPU.
Effective timeout is bounded by remaining lease duration.
checks.limit: Uncooperative non-RSI processes are not prevented by advisory locking. All agents must use supervisor ownership; do not describe exclusive_gpu as a hardware-enforced security property.

checks.area: Control seed and execution network policy
evidence: Host launcher now restricts controls to preregistered screen seeds.
Container runs with network=none; numerical run cannot fetch mutable code or data.

Use baseline-vs-identical-baseline control first, on a screen seed only; do not expose planned holdouts during runner development.
Acquire one live supervisor lease and verify named process/container handles before and after the pilot.
Inspect runtime imports, JIT object/dependency records, exact fingerprints, correctness counts, process teardown and unchanged-control noninferiority.

remaining_policy_recommendations: Use a frozen bounded control retry policy. Preserve failures and do not rerun until a favorable result appears.
Add host-wrapper mocked Docker failure/timeout tests when modifying that cleanup code; current independent executed tests cover coordinator process groups and bundle verification.

control_design_review.reason: CI contains1 is an exact-equality condition, not practical equivalence. A precisely estimated small difference can be acceptable while excluding1.
control_design_review.requested_v4_gate: Each shape CI must lie wholly within[1/1.02,1.02]; primary geometric-mean point estimate must lie in the same band. Retain correctness and a preregistered at-most-one uncertainty-only escalation.
control_design_review.scope: No candidate performance or correctness rejection; this rejects experimental design only.
